Projects

Two illustrative case studies. Use this format to document the constraints, tradeoffs, and validation behind your own work.

Embedded systems · Example

Environmental sensor node

A field sensor has to balance sampling frequency, wireless range, and battery life. The proposed design buffers readings locally and transmits them in batches.

Validation Measure current draw in sleep, sampling, and transmission modes. Compare battery-life estimates with a representative field trial.

Automation · Example

Test telemetry dashboard

When logs live on separate test stations, recurring failures are hard to see. A shared schema records the station, firmware version, and failure reason for each run.

Validation Replay known-good and known-bad runs and reconcile the dashboard totals with the raw logs.
